description: Implementation of the ue_link_adaptation_controller class for LTE/5G link adaptation, managing MCS calculations, link quality metrics, and OLLA adjustments.

classes.name: ue_link_adaptation_controller
classes.description: Controller for UE link adaptation, handling MCS selection, CQI/SNR estimation, and OLLA adjustments.

methods.name: handle_dl_ack_info
methods.description: Processes DL ACK info, updates OLLA if enabled.

methods.name: handle_ul_crc_info
methods.description: Processes UL CRC info, updates OLLA if enabled.

methods.name: get_effective_cqi
methods.description: Calculates effective CQI considering DL outer loop adjustments.

methods.name: get_effective_snr
methods.description: Calculates effective SNR including UL outer loop offset.

methods.name: calculate_dl_mcs
methods.description: Derives DL MCS based on CQI and link adaptation.

methods.name: calculate_ul_mcs
methods.description: Derives UL MCS based on SNR and link adaptation.

methods.name: update_dl_mcs_lims
methods.description: Updates DL MCS limits based on current MCS table.

methods.name: update_ul_mcs_lims
methods.description: Updates UL MCS limits based on current MCS table and transform precoder setting.
